title: Help and Advice
intro: Free, expert and confidential advice for people facing money worries, benefit issues, housing problems and employment concerns.

blocks.heading: Debt and money
paragraphs: Debt Free Advice is here to help with any money worries. Call 0800 808 5701, Monday to Friday, 10am–4pm, or request a callback.

blocks.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: We can help with benefit applications and help you maximise your income.

blocks.heading: Housing and employment
paragraphs: Our Free Legal Advice Centre may be able to help with housing issues and employment rights. Email advice@toynbeehall.org.uk with your name, address and a summary of your issue.
